backend/main.mo: Defines core actor types and state for users, providers, jobs, documents, and MPesa config, including access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata linking features to files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten 1–2 sentence summaries for numerous frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up PWA metadata, manifest, and root mount element.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: IC domain verification file listing genz-app.icp0.io.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining icons, theme colors, metadata, and start configuration.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styling and reload button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, offline fallback, and bypass logic for .well-known and authenticated requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, routing, service worker registration, and role-based page rendering.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main app layout with header, footer, and support drawer wrapping page content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles user authentication via Internet Identity with login/logout logic and UI states.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Guides users to select and save their role using a card-based onboarding interface.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the footer with support trigger, copyright text, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the top navigation bar with dynamic nav items, install prompt, support button, and login control.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Shows animated platform statistics using backend data with minimum thresholds and count-up effects.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays a grid of hardcoded client testimonials with ratings and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Provides a form for selecting address and coordinates, including a button to auto-fill via geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Interactive messaging UI that displays a scrollable message list, lets users send messages, and simulates refresh and delivery states.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Dialog for initiating and simulating M‑Pesa STK payments, with phone validation, polling, and profile updates.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Avatar component for featured providers with image fallback and auto‑generated initials.
Displays a grid of demo featured providers with avatars, ratings, rates, and basic profile info.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Reusable avatar for providers showing a profile image or initials in various sizes.
Provider profile card showing avatar, verification, location, rate, category, and average rating.
Dialog showing an expanded preview of a provider including availability, details, verification, and map links.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: UI card showing provider info and a 10% connection fee with an unlock button and loading state.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Banner prompting users to install the PWA, with special handling for iOS and a dialog showing install steps.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Five-star clickable rating input component with optional readonly mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Support drawer offering phone and email contact details with a closeable drawer UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Hook that animates a number counting up when its element becomes visible using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Hook detecting PWA install availability, iOS conditions, and triggering the installation prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, provider data, searches, and updates.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for light/dark mode and landing page background effects.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service category metadata and helper functions for category lookup and business type labeling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, the query client, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Backoffice page for reviewing providers and updating their verification status with dialogs and tables.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Client page listing service categories with search filtering and navigation to category results.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Renders a map view page with provider listings, showing an alert when Google Maps isn’t configured. Allows navigation back to results and to individual provider details.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Displays the caller’s jobs with status badges, cancellation, and completion with rating. Includes dialogs for rating and navigation to browse services.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Shows detailed provider info, verification status, ratings, and unlock/payment flow. Supports submitting job requests and viewing conversations.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Lists providers matching a selected category with search, preview dialog, and navigation to map or detail views. Handles provider filtering and preview fetching.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page UI with hero section, login flow, and smooth-scroll interaction to testimonials.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Provides a form for providers to edit their profile, upload pictures, and set business details. Loads existing profile data and manages image uploads with progress.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Allows providers to upload verification documents and view current verification status. Includes upload progress tracking and status messaging.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Utility functions for calculating a 10% connection fee and formatting KES currency values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL params (including hash), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s current state, feature requirements, issues, and architectural notes for the Genz App marketplace.
